description: Every substitution returned by the initialized solver is most general, with factorization on all variables and arbitrary residual target alphabets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify_most_general.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L)
  (μ : ℕ → L.Term ℕ) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify P = some μ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.MostGeneral P μ
